question: In July 2025, the Defence Research and Development Organisation successfully conducted flight tests of the Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Launched Precision Guided Missile (ULPGM)-V3 at the National Open Area Range test facility in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kurnool, Andhra Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **July 2025**, the **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)** successfully conducted the flight tests of the **Unmanned Launch Precision Guided Missile (ULPGM)-V3**.
 
• The testing took place at the **National Open Area Range (NOAR)**, which is located in **Kurnool, Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• The **ULPGM-V3** is a sophisticated air-to-surface missile specifically designed to be launched from **Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs)** to engage ground targets with high accuracy.
 
• During the flight tests, the missile's **precision guidance system**, **aerodynamic stability**, and **warhead triggering mechanism** were evaluated under realistic combat scenarios.
 
• This successful trial represents a significant step toward indigenous **precision-strike capabilities** and reduces dependency on foreign weapon systems for India's growing drone fleet.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **DRDO (Defence Research and Development Organisation):**

 
 
• It was established in **1958** and functions under the **Ministry of Defence**, Government of India.
 
• Headquartered in **New Delhi**, its primary mission is to achieve self-reliance in critical defense technologies and systems.
 
• It operates a network of more than **50 laboratories** across the country developing various technologies like aeronautics, armaments, electronics, and missiles.
 
 
 
• **National Open Area Range (NOAR), Kurnool:**
 
 
• Located in the **Orvakal** region of **Kurnool district**, this facility provides a vast, unobstructed area for testing various missile and rocket systems.
 
• It complements other major testing sites like the **Integrated Test Range (ITR)** at **Chandipur, Odisha**.
 
• The **Andhra Pradesh** government has been actively supporting the development of defense corridors and specialized testing ranges within the state.
 
 
 
• **Unmanned Launch Precision Guided Missiles (ULPGM):**
 
 
• These are "smart" munitions that utilize **laser guidance**, **GPS**, or **Inertial Navigation Systems (INS)** to strike targets with minimal collateral damage.
 
• The integration of such missiles with indigenous UAVs like the **TAPAS-BH-201** or **Archer** enhances the tactical offensive reach of the **Indian Armed Forces**.
 
• The **V3 variant** indicates an advanced iteration with improved range, seeker technology, and weight-to-payload ratio.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Strategic Significance:** The development of the **ULPGM-V3** aligns with the **Atmanirbhar Bharat** (Self-Reliant India) initiative in the defense sector.
 
• **Recent Trends:** Modern warfare is increasingly shifting toward **Unmanned Combat Aerial Vehicles (UCAVs)**, making specialized miniature precision munitions a critical requirement for **21st-century** defense strategy.
 
• **Geographic Location:** **Kurnool** is strategically chosen for its topography and lower population density, ensuring safety during high-velocity **missile flight trials**.
